summary: Frontend-only retest of Portfolio-OS Phase 2 (iteration_1 fixes). Both reported UI bugs are FIXED: (1) mobile nav drawer now exists and works at 390x844 — mobile-menu-toggle visible/clickable, mobile-drawer opens, all 8 mobile-nav-* links render, clicking mobile-nav-projects navigates to /projects and drawer auto-closes on route change; (2) no horizontal overflow at 390px on /, /projects, /labs (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390) and projects-filters wraps inside viewport (box x=24, width=342). Desktop/tablet: nav-projects visible and mobile-menu-toggle correctly hidden at both 768px and 1920px. Regressions all green: Cmd+K palette opens, palette-input filters (2 results for 'proj'), Escape closes; contact form submits successfully (contact-success 'sent · id ...'); API playground GET /projects returns api-status-code 200. Backend pytest intentionally not re-run per request.

minor.issue: 422 validation detail from Pydantic EmailStr is surfaced verbatim to the UI ('value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name...'). Functional and visible, but raw/technical copy for end users. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional polish: map backend 422 email validation message to a friendly string (e.g. 'Please enter a valid email address') instead of echoing Pydantic detail.
critical_code_review_comments: TopBar.jsx mobile drawer implementation is correct: useEffect on pathname closes drawer, md:hidden on toggle and drawer keeps desktop clean, aria-expanded/aria-controls present.
seed_data_creation: 2 TEST_ contact messages created via UI submissions; both deleted from portfolio_contact_messages after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_1 mobile-nav and filter-overflow bugs are verified fixed at 390x844. Note: use a real TLD for contact-form email in tests — '.test'/'.invalid' domains are rejected by Pydantic EmailStr (a 422 with those is expected behaviour, not a bug). Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py was 19/19 in iteration_1 and backend code unchanged.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial contact-form failure in this pass was a test-data defect on my side (qa.bot@example.test — reserved TLD rejected by email-validator), not an app bug; re-run with example.com succeeded and the error path also renders correctly.
